faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Can't find your answer? Reach out via the Complaints menu.
faq.stillHaveQuestionsDesc: Reach out via complaints (anonymous) or request a direct consultation with our staff.

cara-ambil-antrian.q: How do I get a queue number?
cara-ambil-antrian.a: Queue numbers are taken directly from the screen/tablet available at the BPS Kota Jambi service area.

jam-pelayanan.q: What are BPS Kota Jambi's service hours?
jam-pelayanan.a: Monday–Thursday: 08:00–15:30 WIB. Friday: 08:00–16:00 WIB. Saturday–Sunday: closed.

cara-penilaian.q: I've been served — how do I leave a rating?
cara-penilaian.a: A rating link automatically appears on your queue ticket page once service is complete. Give 1–5 stars plus a comment to help us improve our service quality.

harus-datang-langsung.q: Do I have to come in person for a consultation or data request?
harus-datang-langsung.a: Not always. Submit a data request or consultation through the online form in the Data Request menu — from anywhere, anytime (the form is open during service hours). You'll get a unique link to communicate directly with staff.

kehilangan-link-permintaan.q: I lost my data request tracking link — what now?
kehilangan-link-permintaan.a: Open the Data Request menu → "Submitted a request before?" → enter the email you used when submitting. All requests under that email will be shown, each with a link to its own page.

chat-jam-tertentu.q: Why can't I send a message at certain hours?
chat-jam-tertentu.a: Chat with staff is only active during service hours. Outside those hours, chat history remains readable, but new messages can only be sent again once service hours resume.

privasi-permintaan.q: Can other people see my data request?
privasi-permintaan.a: No. Every request has a unique, unguessable link — only whoever holds the link (or knows the registered email) can access its conversation.

anonimitas-pengaduan.q: Will my identity be known when I file a complaint?
anonimitas-pengaduan.a: No. Complaints are fully anonymous — we deliberately don't ask for your name, email, or any contact details. After submitting, you'll get a link and a unique token code to track its progress.

kehilangan-link-pengaduan.q: I lost my complaint link/token — what now?
kehilangan-link-pengaduan.a: Unlike data requests, complaints don't store an email — so the link or token itself is the only way to recover access. Open the Complaints menu → "Filed a complaint before?" and paste the link/token you saved. If both are truly lost, we're sorry but that conversation cannot be recovered — this is the trade-off of keeping full anonymity.

lama-tindak-lanjut.q: How long does it take for my complaint to be followed up?
lama-tindak-lanjut.a: Follow-up time varies depending on complexity. You can check its status (New/In Progress/Resolved) anytime via the link/token provided.

apa-itu-pesta-koja.a: Pesta Koja (Jambi City Statistical Services) is a one-stop hub for all of BPS Kota Jambi's digital services — from WhatsApp consultation (PANDAWA), a digital library, statistical recommendations, microdata purchases, and data needs surveys, to public information access (PPID).

lihat-jadwal-petugas.q: Can I see the staff duty schedule?
lihat-jadwal-petugas.a: Currently, the full staff schedule is only accessible to logged-in staff and admins, as part of internal management.

profile.title: BPS Kota Jambi (Jambi City Statistics Office)
profile.desc1: BPS Kota Jambi is a vertical agency of Statistics Indonesia (BPS) tasked with providing quality statistical data for development planning in Jambi City — from censuses and surveys, sectoral statistical publications, to data consultation services for the public, academics, and government agencies.
profile.desc2: Through Simpatik, we aim to ensure that everyone who needs statistical data or services can be served quickly, transparently, and conveniently — whether visiting in person or online.
